questions.q: A man's annual income has increased by $1.8$ lakhs but the tax on income that he has to pay has reduced from $15\%$ to $12\%$. He now pays the same amount of tax as before. What is his increased income (in lakhs)?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, jab tax amount same hai toh Income aur Tax Rate ka ratio inversely proportional hoga. Tax rate ka ratio $15:12 = 5:4$ hai. Toh Income ka ratio inverse yani $4:5$ ho jayega. Difference aya $1$ unit ka, jo sawal me $1.8$ lakh ke barabar diya hai. Pucha kya hai? Nayi (increased) income, jo ki $5$ unit hai. Seedha multiply maar: $5 \times 1.8 = 9$ lakh. Pen uthane ki jarurat hi nahi thi, basic ratio ka khel hai!

questions.q: In a group of 50 people, 28 like tea, 26 like coffee, and 12 like both. Find the number of people who like only coffee.
questions.s: Dekh bhai, ye question bas dara raha hai. Hame 'Only coffee' nikalna hai. Iska matlab total coffee peene walo mein se unko hata do jo dono peete hain. Seedha $26 - 12 = 14$. Venn diagram ka sabse basic concept! SSC CGL me aise free ke marks mat chhodna!

questions.q: In an examination a candidate had to sit for three papers A, B, and C. The candidate secured $70\%$ marks in Paper A, $80\%$ marks in Paper B, and $50\%$ marks in Paper C. If the weightage assigned to Papers A, B, and C were $30\%$, $60\%$ and $20\%$, respectively, then find the weighted percentage of marks obtained by the candidate, when all the three papers were taken together?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, weighted average ka jalwa dekh! Weightage percentages ko direct ratio bana le: $30:60:20$ yani $3:6:2$. Ab deviation method ya direct average laga de: $\frac{3 \times 70 + 6 \times 80 + 2 \times 50}{3+6+2} = \frac{210 + 480 + 100}{11} = \frac{790}{11}$. Pura divide mat kar! $11 \times 7 = 77$, bacha $20$, $11 \times 1 = 11$. laghbhag $71.81\%$. Options dekh ke hi eliminations se tick maar de!

questions.q: If the length of a rectangular field is increased by $25\%$, then by what percentage should its breadth be reduced so that the area of the field remains constant? (CHSL TIER I - $\frac{29}{11}$/2025-SHIFT 3)
questions.s: Dekh bhai aise karna hai... AB Rule zindabad! Area constant hai, isliye agar length fraction me $\frac{1}{4}$ se badhti hai ($+25\%$), toh breadth hamesha $\frac{1}{4+1}$ yaani $\frac{1}{5}$ se ghategi. $\frac{1}{5}$ ka standard percentage value $20\%$ hota hai. Ye pattern har shift me aayega, rat lo is trick ko!

questions.q: Raman saves $x\%$ of her income. If her income increases by $16\%$ and expenditure increases by $10\%$ then her savings increased by $50\%$. What is the value of x?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, jab bhi Income, Expenditure aur Saving ka percentage increase/decrease de, aankh band karke Alligation laga de! Expenditure increase ($10\%$) aur Saving increase ($50\%$) mix hoke overall Income increase ($16\%$) banate hain. Ratio of Exp to Sav $= (50-16) : (16-10) = 34:6$, jisko simplify kar ke $17:3$ banayenge. Total income = $17+3 = 20$ units. Saving ka percentage $= \frac{3}{20} \times 100 = 15\%$. Secondon ka game hai!

questions.q: A contractor estimated that a project would cost $\text{Rs. } 5,00,000$. He planned for $60\%$ of the cost to go to materials, $25\%$ to labor, and the rest as contingency. However, due to delays, material cost increased by $12.5\%$, labor cost increased by $10\%$, and contingency remained unchanged. What is the new total cost?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, gadho ki tarah badi calculations mat kar! Sirf extra cost (increase) nikal. Material tha $60\%$, uspe $12.5\%$ (yani $\frac{1}{8}$) badha $\implies \frac{60}{8} = 7.5\%$ overall increase. Labour tha $25\%$, uspe $10\%$ badha $\implies 2.5\%$ overall increase. Contingency par koi farq nahi pada. Total cost badhi $= 7.5\% + 2.5\% = 10\%$. Base $5,00,000$ ka $10\% = 50,000$ hota hai. Nayi cost ho gayi $5,00,000 + 50,000 = 5,50,000$.

questions.q: A fruit seller had some apples and oranges. He sold $25\%$ apples to person A, $30\%$ of the remaining to person B and had 42 apples left. Similarly, he sold $30\%$ oranges to A, 60 oranges to B and had $20\%$ Oranges left. What is the total number of apples and oranges that the fruit seller had initially?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, isko tukdo me tod. Apples ke liye Successive laga: Initial $\times \frac{3}{4} \times \frac{7}{10} = 42 \implies$ Initial Apples $= 80$. Oranges ke liye line method socho: $30\%$ shuru me becha, bache hue me se $60$ aur beche toh end me $20\%$ bacha. Matlab $(100\% - 30\% - 20\%) = 50\%$ ki actual value $60$ oranges hai. Agar $50\% = 60$, toh total $100\%$ oranges $= 120$. Total fruits $= 80 + 120 = 200$. Concept ki clarity speed banayegi!

questions.q: Sujata spends $22\%$ of her monthly income on house rent, $45\%$ of the income on groceries and $60\%$ of the remaining on her children education and others. If her only savings is 6,300 then her expenditure on 'education and others' is?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, successive ka best shortcut use karte hain. Total direct kharch $22\% + 45\% = 67\%$ ho gaya. Bacha $33\%$. Ab iss $33\%$ ka $60\%$ education pe gaya aur $40\%$ saving ($\text{Rs. } 6300$) bani. Education aur Saving ka aapas me ratio $60:40$ yaani $3:2$ hai. Agar $2$ unit ki value $6300$ hai, toh hume $3$ unit nikalna hai: $3150 \times 3 = 9450$. Tum isme Digital Sum bhi laga sakte the, $3$ ka multiple $\times 3 = 9$ ka multiple! Ek hi option $9$ se kat raha hai!

questions.q: A number is mistakenly multiplied by $\frac{7}{5}$ instead of being multiplied by $\frac{3}{2}$. What is the percentage change in the result due to this mistake?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, fractions ko seedha integers me badal le. Dono denominators $2$ aur $5$ ka LCM le kar original number ko $10$ maan le. Sahi answer aana chahiye tha: $10 \times \frac{3}{2} = 15$. Galat answer aaya: $10 \times \frac{7}{5} = 14$. Error kitne ka aaya? $1$ ka error aaya $15$ par. $\frac{1}{15}$ fraction ki direct percentage value $6 \frac{2}{3}\%$ hoti hai. Standard fractions tips pe yaad hone chahiye CGL nikalne ke liye!

questions.q: B's required target was $20\%$ more than A's. However, A completed his target but B completed only $80\%$ of his target. If B completed 96 units, what was A's target?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, bina pen chalae dimag me figure out kar! Maan le A ka target $100$ hai. Toh B ka target usse $20\%$ jyada yaani $120$ hoga. B ne sirf apne target ka $80\%$ hi complete kiya, yani $120$ ka $80\% = 96$ units. Question me bhi completion exactly $96$ units hi diya hai! Jab ratio aur exact value match ho jaye toh A ka target $100$ units hi tha. Free marks the ye!

questions.q: After sports day in a college, the college awarded medals in different categories. 72 medals in Athletics, 24 medals in weightlifting and 36 medals in swimming. If these medals went to a total of 90 persons and only 8 persons got medals in all the three sports, how many received medals in exactly two of these sports?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, Venn diagram ki standard property lagayenge jo mains me aati hai. Maan lo exactly 1 wale $x$, exactly 2 wale $y$, aur exactly 3 wale $z$ log hain. Total Log: $x + y + z = 90$. Total Medals ka sum: $x + 2y + 3z = 72 + 24 + 36 = 132$. Hame given hai $z = 8$. Dusri equation me se pehli equation minus karega toh aayega: $y + 2z = 42 \implies y + 16 = 42 \implies y = 26$. Exactly two sports wale $26$ nikle!

questions.q: In an election between A and B, every fifth vote polled was marked as invalid by the machine. In the remaining votes, A wins the election with a margin of 2500 votes or $10\%$ of the total valid votes polled, over B. If $90\%$ of the invalid votes would have been in favour of B, then which of the following would have been the result of the election?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, tagda twist hai isme! Margin $= 2500$ votes, jo 'valid votes' ka $10\%$ hai. Toh Valid votes hue $25000$. Har $5$ me se $1$ invalid tha, yani $4/5$ valid the. Toh Total Votes $= 31250$, isme se Invalid hue $6250$. Pehle A jeet raha tha $2500$ ke margin se. Ab agar invalid count ho jayein toh B ko $90\%$ ($5625$ votes) milte hain aur A ko bache $10\%$ ($625$ votes). Naya advantage B ko gaya $5000$ votes ka. Pehle A $2500$ aage tha, toh ab B overall $+2500$ aage ho jayega. Total $31250$ pe $2500$ ka margin matlab $\frac{2500}{31250} \times 100 = 8\%$. Shandaar elimination round!

questions.q: A spider climbed $62.5\%$ of the height of the pole in one hour and in the next hour it covered $12.5\%$ of the remaining height. If the pole's height is 192 m, then the distance climbed in the second hour is?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, fractions yaad honge toh question makhan ki tarah banega. $62.5\% = \frac{5}{8}$ height cover ho chuki. Bachi kitni? $\frac{3}{8}$. Agle ghante me is bachi hui height ka $12.5\%$ yani $\frac{1}{8}$ cover kiya. Total height ka ratio kitna bana? $\frac{3}{8} \times \frac{1}{8} = \frac{3}{64}$. Base height $192$ hai, uska $\frac{3}{64}$ hissa nikal de $\implies 192 \times \frac{3}{64} = 9$ meters. Direct multiple hai!

questions.q: In an election between two candidates A and B, $8.33\%$ of voters did not cast their vote, and $18.18\%$ of votes of the casted votes were declared invalid. Candidate A gets $31.25\%$ of the votes of total voters and he lost by 100 votes. Find the total number of voters?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, fractions ka magic lagate hain yahan! $8.33\% = \frac{1}{12}$, $18.18\% = \frac{2}{11}$, aur $31.25\% = \frac{5}{16}$. Denominators $12, 11, 16$ ka LCM leke Total Voters $528$ units maan le jisse decimal na aaye. Vote dale gaye $= 528 \times \frac{11}{12} = 484$. Valid Votes $= 484 \times \frac{9}{11} = 396$. A ko mila list ka $\frac{5}{16}$ yani $165$. B ko valid me se bache hue mile: $396 - 165 = 231$. Unka margin: $231 - 165 = 66$ units. Question me $66$ units $= 100$ votes diya hai. Toh total voters ($528$ units) barabar honga: $8 \times 100 = 800$ votes! Khatarnaak shortcut!

questions.q: Out of his total income, Mr. Kapoor spends $20\%$ on house rent and $70\%$ of the rest on household expenses. If he saves $\text{Rs. } 1800$, what is his total income?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, Successive percentage ka sabse basic sawal hai. $20\%$ (yani $\frac{1}{5}$) kharch kiya toh $\frac{4}{5}$ bacha. Fir $70\%$ kharch kiya toh us bache hue ka $30\%$ (yani $\frac{3}{10}$) saving hui. Overall bachat hui: $\frac{4}{5} \times \frac{3}{10} = \frac{12}{50}$ yaani $24\%$. Ab is $24\%$ ki value hi $\text{Rs. } 1800$ hai. Toh $100\%$ income barabar hogi: $\frac{1800}{24} \times 100 = 75 \times 100 = 7500$. Approximation se options aise hi eliminate ho jayenge.

questions.q: What will be the difference in population 3 years ago and 2 years ago of a town, whose current population is 190000 and which is increasing at a rate of $25\%$ every year?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, peeche se socho time bachane ke liye. Har saal $25\%$ hike matlab population $4$ se $5$ ho rahi hai. $3$ saal pehle agar wo $4^3 = 64$ units thi, toh current me badh kar $5^3 = 125$ units ho gayi. Diya gaya hai $125$ units $= 190000$, toh $1$ unit $= 1520$. Difference between $3$ years ago ($64$ units) and $2$ years ago ($64 \times 1.25 = 80$ units) is $16$ units. Direct nikal: $16 \times 1520 = 24320$. Option me Unit digit verify kar ke aage badho!

questions.q: A reduction of $7.5\%$ in the cost price of a commodity enables a shopkeeper to purchase 15 kg more than what he previously purchased for a sum of $\text{Rs. } 7,400$. In order to make a profit of $32.5\%$ on the pre-reduction cost price of the commodity, at what price (in Rs) per kg should the commodity be sold?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, SSC ka all-time favorite format! Kharch fixed hai $\text{Rs. } 7400$. Usme se $7.5\%$ bachata hai, yani $\text{Rs. } 555$ uske bache! In $\text{Rs. } 555$ me $15$ kg extra samaan aata hai, toh naya (reduced) price hua $\frac{555}{15} = \text{Rs. } 37$/kg. Yeh price original ka $92.5\%$ hai. Toh base (original) price nikla $\text{Rs. } 40$/kg. Hame is original par $32.5\%$ ka profit chahiye. Smartly fraction lo: $32.5\% = \frac{13}{40}$. Toh profit $\text{Rs. } 13$ ka hua, jisse SP aayega $40 + 13 = 53$.

questions.q: If an employee's income is $\text{Rs. } 72,000$, the amount he spends is $40\%$ higher than his savings. Therefore, his savings (in Rs.) is:
questions.s: Dekh bhai, percentage ko ratio se tod do. Saving ko agar $100$ maano, toh Expenditure usse $40\%$ jyada yani $140$ hoga. Ratio hua $5:7$. Total Income $5 + 7 = 12$ units hui. $12$ unit barabar hai $\text{Rs. } 72,000$ ke, matlab ek unit $\text{Rs. } 6000$ ke. Humne Saving $5$ units maani thi na? $5 \times 6000 = 30000$. Secondon me solved bina algebra ke!

questions.q: If the surface area of a sphere is increased by $44\%$, by what percentage does the volume of the sphere increase? (CHSL TIER I - $\frac{22}{11}$/2025 - SHIFT 1)
questions.s: Dekh bhai, Surface Area $r^2$ pe chalta hai aur Volume $r^3$ par. Area badha $44\%$, yani $100$ se $144$ ho gaya. Toh iska square root nikalo, Radius $10$ se $12$ ho jayegi (jo ki $20\%$ ki pure vridhi hai). Volume me yahi radius ka cube karna padta hai: $(1.2)^3 = 1.728$. Yani ki final volume me seedha $72.8\%$ ka jump ayega! Ye standard successive values yaad honi chahiye CGL crack karne ke liye.

questions.q: Kavita buys 2 apples and 5 mangoes for 239. When the cost of an apple is decreased by $50\%$ and that of a mango remains the same, then the cost of 2 apples and 4 mangoes is 184. What is the original cost of 8 apples and 8 mangoes?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, equations likh kar lamba mat kheechna. Pehli condition me cost $2A + 5M = 239$ thi. Dusri me Apple aadha hua toh $1A + 4M = 184$. Is dusri equation ko double kar de: $2A + 8M = 368$. Ab isme se pehli ($2A + 5M = 239$) ghata de. Farq aya $3$ Mangoes ka $\text{Rs. } 129$, yani Ek Mango $= 43$. Apple ki cost niklegi $\text{Rs. } 12$. Pucha kya hai? $8(A+M)$. Toh $8 \times (12+43) = 8 \times 55 = 440$. Exact value aur 11 ka multiple concept ek saath!

questions.q: In a factory with 400 employees, the ratio of the number of male employees to that of female employees is 5:3. There are $87.5\%$ regular employees in the factory. If $92\%$ of male employees are regular employees, then what is the percentage of regular female employees?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, 400 ki value se calculate karega toh mazdoor kahlaga. JSM ya Weighted Average laga! Male:Female ka ratio $5:3$ hai, total base hua $8$. Overall $87.5\%$ log regular hain. Deviation check kar: Male ka average se $+4.5\%$ deviation hai, 5 males par total net $+22.5\%$ ho gaya. Isko balance karne ke liye Females ko average se minus me jana padega. $22.5$ ko $3$ (Females) pe baant do: $-7.5\%$. Toh Female ki exact regular $\% = 87.5 - 7.5 = 80\%$. Smart bano, CGL inspector post maangta hai mehnat nahi!

questions.q: Seventy-five percent of a number is 15 more than two-thirds of that number. Find the number. (CGL TIER I $\frac{16}{09}$/2025-S2)
questions.s: Dekh bhai, fraction aur percentage ko mix karne ka badhiya sawal. $75\%$ ko hum fraction me $\frac{3}{4}$ bolte hain, aur two-thirds toh $\frac{2}{3}$ hai hi. Dono fractions ka denominator barabar kar: $\frac{9}{12}$ aur $\frac{8}{12}$. Inka farq (difference) kitna aaya? $\frac{1}{12}$ aaya. Question kehta hai yahi difference $15$ ka hai. Toh poora number (yani total $12$ units) $= 12 \times 15 = 180$. Approximation aur common LCM se pen-free solution milta hai.

questions.q: Three candidates P, Q and R contested an election. Out of the total votes on a voter list $25\%$ did not vote and $20\%$ of the polled votes were invalid. R got 7500 votes which were $25\%$ more than that of what Q got. If P got only $45\%$ of the total votes, then find out the number of votes the winner got?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, logic lagayenge! Total list ka $25\%$ vote daalne nahi gaye, bache $75\%$. Iska bhi $20\%$ invalid hua, yani sirf $\frac{4}{5} \times 75\% = 60\%$ vote valid thhe. R ko $7500$ votes mile, jo Q se $25\%$ (yani $\frac{1}{4}$) jyada the $\implies$ Q ko $6000$ vote mile. P ko poori list ka $45\%$ mila. Toh valid votes mein se P ka share $45\%$ hata de, toh $15\%$ bacha. Ye $15\%$ share Q aur R ($7500 + 6000 = 13500$) ka hoga. Agar $15\% = 13500$, hamein P (winner) ke vote (yani $45\%$) nikalne hain. Seedha $3$ guna kar! $13500 \times 3 = 40500$!

questions.q: The cost of a washing machine is $25\%$ less than the cost of a TV. If the cost of the washing machine increases by $66\%$ and that of the TV decreases by $40\%$, then what is the percentage change in the total cost of 7 washing machines and 8 TVs?
questions.s: Dekh bhai, isko JSM (Junior Satisfactory Method) ya Weighted Average method se fodenge! Ratio diya hai W:T = $3:4$. Hame chahiye quantity ratio $7W$ aur $8T$, toh inka price ratio multiply ho jayega: $7 \times 3 = 21$ aur $8 \times 4 = 32$. W me $+66\%$ ka change hai, T me $-40\%$ ka change hai. Overall change: $\frac{21 \times 66 + 32 \times (-40)}{21 + 32} = \frac{1386 - 1280}{53} = \frac{106}{53} = +2\%$. Positive answer ka matlab Increase by $2\%$. Mains me time aur paper dono bachega is trick se!
